unit_attributes.statement: The purpose of 8 FAM 801.2 is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).

Information request letters (IRLs) are personalized, standardized letters with a date and signature block that request from the applicant additional information, documentation, or action needed to process the passport application.
You must fully adjudicate the passport application prior to suspending to ensure that you are addressing all issues.
The IRLs have been carefully crafted to communicate clearly and accurately statutory, regulatory, and other requirements of the Department.

unit_attributes.logic_explanation: Passport agencies and centers are prohibited from making unilateral changes or alterations to IRLs without CA/PPT/S/A approval, except when extenuating circumstances exist and agency/center management approves on a case-by-case basis.
unit_attributes.statement: Passport agencies/centers must not make unilateral changes or alterations to the IRLs without the approval of the Office of Adjudication (CA/PPT/S/A), except on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management in extenuating circumstances (e.g., when requesting that the applicant submit a birth certificate instead of a notification of birth registration, and the applicant insists that the notification of birth registration is the birth certificate).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applicable to passport agencies/centers modifying IRLs.

unit_attributes.statement: Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs.
Posts are authorized to modify the language in the IRLs to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applicable to Posts adapting IRL language for local logistical requirements or other local concerns.

unit_attributes.statement: The passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with the 8 FAM and then the appropriate IRL selected to address any deficiencies with the passport or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA).
Information notices (INs) are standardized notices that provide passport bearers with information about their passports.
An IN may be included to explain why the passport was limited in validity, and/or what documentation is needed to obtain a fully valid passport.
The INs have been carefully crafted to communicate their information clearly and accurately.

unit_attributes.logic_explanation: Unilateral changes or alterations to INs at passport agencies/centers are prohibited without CA/PPT/S/A approval, with an exception for extenuating circumstances where passport agency/center management approves on a case-by-case basis.
unit_attributes.statement: No changes or alterations to the INs may be made unilaterally at passport agencies/centers without the approval of CA/PPT/S/A, except in extenuating circumstances on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management (e.g., when using an endorsement 46 to limit a passport for a special problem).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applicable to passport agencies/centers modifying INs.
unit_attributes.modality_quote: no changes or alterations to the INs may be made

unit_attributes.statement: INs do not require a response from the applicant and do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.

unit_attributes.logic_explanation: Posts have permission to either consult Passport Services' IRL index and IN Index, or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov, when tailoring correspondence to a situation.
unit_attributes.statement: When tailoring correspondence to a situation, Posts may consult Passport Services’ IRL index and IN Index or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When tailoring correspondence to a situation.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Posts may either consult Passport Services’ IRL index and IN Index or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov.
